title: Cancer: current or history, and metastases
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's cancer as documented at this visit.
note:
Chief Complaint
Pain in the lower back and hips.

HPI
The patient is an 85-year-old man presenting for a follow-up regarding his history of colon cancer. He underwent surgical removal and treatment for the primary malignancy several years ago. He reports that his previous treatment is complete and he currently feels stable regarding the primary site. However, he is now complaining of localized aching in his spine and hips. He describes the pain as a dull, constant ache that has intensified over the last month.

Medication List
Acetaminophen 650mg every 6 hours as needed for pain.

Exam
The patient is alert and oriented. He appears in mild discomfort during the physical exam. There are no new skin lesions or visible masses. Palpation of the lumbar spine reveals localized tenderness. Movement of the hips is restricted by discomfort.

Assessment
1. Colon cancer: The primary site shows no evidence of local recurrence.
2. Bone metastases: The patient has developed metastases to bone, which is the primary focus of today's visit.

Plan
We will initiate a regimen of scheduled acetaminophen to manage the pain associated with the bone metastasis. We will monitor his comfort levels and reassess his pain management plan in one month.

Electronically signed, P. O'Brien, MD, 05/14/2026
explanations: The colon cancer was excised or eradicated, no treatment is directed to it and there is no evidence of it: personal history Z85.038 (no HCC). Any metastasis is still coded as a current secondary malignancy.
Bone metastases: C79.51, secondary malignant neoplasm of bone (HCC 18, which outranks the primary-site HCC).

distractors.why: Treatment ended and there is no evidence of the primary: code personal history (Z85), not active cancer.
Metastasis is coded as a secondary malignancy, even when the primary is history.
The metastases are in bone, not the liver.

hccs.label: Cancer Metastatic to Bone/Other and Unspecified Metastatic Cancer; Acute Leukemia Except Myeloid
